selected_evidence.summary: The hidden telemetry cache contained one 690,073,600-byte collector debug capture, with no process holding it open.
Usage was initially 100%; after removing the debug capture it measured 7% with 659 MiB available.

selected_evidence.requirement: Ensure archiveapp can write to incoming
selected_evidence.summary: The baseline archiveapp write failed with ENOSPC. After recovery, archiveapp created and synced a 17-byte file owned archiveapp:archiveapp with mode 0640.

selected_evidence.requirement: Preserve the filesystem and existing archive data
